summary: Duolingo is growing users fast: Q3 2026 DAUs were up 29% to 64.9 million, and revenue rose 14% to $309.0 million. Monetization and profitability are lagging, though. Operating income fell and paid subscribers grew roughly half as fast as users, so the open question is whether the user-first strategy will convert to bookings at a time when AI-native speaking apps are competing harder and user sentiment around the energy system and the AI-first memo is weak.

facts.text: Q3 2026 daily active users were 64.9 million, up 29% from 50.5 million. This is reported independently by Motley Fool and matches the company's release.

evidence.quote: Daily active users: 64.9 million, up 29% from 50.5 million
We had a great Q3, with DAU growth accelerating to 29% year over year

facts.text: Q3 2026 revenue was $309.0 million, up 14% year over year. Subscription bookings were $278.4 million, up 16%.

evidence.quote: Revenue: $309.0 million, up 14% year over year

facts.text: GAAP operating income fell to $24.2 million from $35.2 million. Spending rose 24%, including a new bonus tied to user growth.

evidence.quote: Operating profit fell as spending, including a new bonus tied to user growth, rose 24%

facts.text: DAU growth has been accelerating. Q2 2026 growth was 23% year over year, and an August SEC filing cited preliminary DAU growth of 27.4%.

evidence.quote: Duolingo’s latest quarterly release on August 5 said second-quarter daily active user growth accelerated to 23% year over year

facts.text: Management says it is prioritizing user growth and teaching quality in 2026 and plans to gradually put more focus on bookings while preserving the free experience. This is company statement.

evidence.quote: we’ll keep making Duolingo even more fun and effective, while gradually putting more focus on growing bookings in ways that preserve the quality of our free experience
In 2026, we are deliberately prioritizing user growth and teaching better

facts.text: The company says it closed 2025 with more than 50 million DAUs and more than $1 billion in bookings. This is self-reported, from Duolingo's LinkedIn.

evidence.quote: We closed 2025 with strong momentum, surpassing 50 million daily active users and generating more than $1 billion in bookings for the first time

facts.text: Duolingo describes itself as the top-grossing Education app on both Google Play and the Apple App Store. This is self-reported.

evidence.quote: the top-grossing app in the Education category on both Google Play and the Apple App Store

facts.text: Duolingo is named alongside a set of competing language apps in reviews: Babbel, Speak, Praktika, Busuu, Memrise, Rosetta Stone, Pimsleur, TalkPal, ELSA, and the human-tutor marketplaces Preply and italki. Several of these reviews are written by the competitors themselves.

evidence.quote: The table below compares the 10 best alternatives to Duolingo side by side
This guide compares options like Babbel, Duolingo, Busuu, and Speak
Duolingo, Babbel, Speak, ELSA, TalkPal, Praktika, Memrise, Busuu and Pimsleur AI also reviewed

risks.text: Monetization is lagging user growth. Paid subscribers grew only about half as fast as DAUs, and operating income declined.

evidence.quote: Paid subscribers grew only about half as fast as daily users

risks.text: Duolingo is reportedly discontinuing its most expensive tier, Max, which included AI video-call conversation that cost about 30 cents per call in compute. This raises questions about premium pricing and the economics of AI features. The source is a single LinkedIn commentator.

evidence.quote: When they launched it, each call cost the company about 30 cents in computing

risks.text: There is competitive pressure from AI-native speaking apps such as Praktika, Speak, and TalkPal that position themselves as better for conversation. Babbel is positioned as the better choice for structured learning.

evidence.quote: If speaking is your main goal, start with the apps built around conversation: Praktika, Speak and TalkPal
Babbel is the best choice if you’re looking for a clear, structured path that builds real-world skills step by step
If you want the most rigorous grammar foundation, choose Babbel

risks.text: Users are frustrated with the energy system's paywall and ad mechanics, which some say hurts retention. This is anecdotal Reddit evidence.

evidence.quote: if you want to keep studying, you either have to pay to get more or watch ads
The "Energy System" is actively destroying their user retention

risks.text: The April 2025 AI-first memo caused reputational damage, with reported app deletions, a social-media backlash, and subsequent walk-backs.

evidence.quote: Duolingo's April 2025 'AI-first' memo from CEO Luis von Ahn triggered mass app deletions, a TikTok follower exodus, and a year of walk-backs
Many professionals shared that they were either considering deleting the app and canceling their premium service, or had already done so

risks.text: There is past data-security exposure: scraped data from 2.6 million accounts was offered on hacking forums via an exposed API. The company characterized this as scraping, not a breach.

evidence.quote: In a statement to Top Class Actions, Duolingo says its investigation confirmed this was not a breach or a hack but rather a scrape of data from public Duolingo profiles
In the post, the hacker said they obtained the information from scraping an exposed application programming interface (API) and provided a sample of data from 1,000 accounts

open_questions: What are paid subscriber growth, conversion rate, and ARPU trends, and when does management expect the bookings focus to reaccelerate monetization?
Why is Max being discontinued, and what are the per-user compute costs of AI features and their effect on gross margin?
How large is the user-growth bonus, how is it structured, and how long will it weigh on operating margins?
How are DAU-to-MAU retention and cohort engagement changing after the energy system rollout?
Is Duolingo losing share among speaking-focused learners to Speak, Praktika, and other AI tutors, according to independent data?
